_readme: Hand-built mapping from Elite Dangerous journal identifiers to Elite Explorer's own Guardian site-type enum. Sourced independently from the public journal manual (https://elite-journal.readthedocs.io/) and our own CodexEntry cross-checks. Not derived from any third-party tool's source. Extend only from things we've verified ourselves.

codexFallback.note: Used only to confirm/fill origin lat-long when ApproachSettlement wasn't seen; Name_Localised is stored as a secondary label, not used for siteType classification since it's a display string that can be ambiguous across ruin sizes.
